    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    r = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row))

        end = markers[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(markers) else len(grid[r]) - 1
        height = end - c
        top = max(0, r - height)
        for rr in range(top, r):
            out[rr][c] = grid[r][c] if rr == top else 1
    return out
